## Note on the Handbook

`docs/source/handbook/` and the PDF are generated from
`resources/GRANDlib_Handbook.zip`, which this repository does not own. Where it
disagrees with the code, the code is right; the errata table on the Handbook
landing page is where such disagreements are recorded, and it is the place to
add one rather than editing the generated pages.
